# @sharadox/account-web-library

> Passwordless accounts for web applications (one-time codes to contacts, TOTP two-factor, roles and bans per application, OpenID Connect for people and agents), built on standards without an auth framework. 0.1.0: building blocks and account storage in Postgres (Kysely).

- /username: checkUsername(name) → { valid: true, username, key (lowercase) } | { valid: false, reason: "length" | "characters" }; rules /^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:[-_.][A-Za-z0-9]+)*$/, 1–50 (USERNAME_MAXIMUM_LENGTH); usernameKey(name) → lowercase (unique index; abc = aBc)
- /one-time-code: createOneTimeCode(length = 8) → digits (crypto.randomInt); hashOneTimeCode(code, { pepper (≥32 chars), purpose }) → base64url HMAC-SHA-256 of `${purpose}\n${code}`; matchesOneTimeCode(code, hash, options) → boolean, spaces ignored, constant-time
- /totp: createTotpSecret() → 20 random bytes; totpCode(secret, nowMs, { digits = 6, period = 30 }) (RFC 6238 SHA-1); verifyTotp(secret, code, nowMs, { lastUsedStep }) → { valid: true, step } | { valid: false }, window ±1 step, steps ≤ lastUsedStep refused; totpUri({ issuer, account, secret }) → otpauth://totp/Issuer:account?secret=BASE32&issuer=…&algorithm=SHA1&digits=6&period=30
- /base-32: encodeBase32(bytes) (RFC 4648, no padding); decodeBase32(text) (case, spaces, = ignored; throws on other characters)
- /effective-permissions: effectivePermissions({ application, resource?, now, defaultRole, roles: Role[] { id, application|null, permissions, exclusive }, grants: Grant[] { roleId, application|null, resource|null, startsAt, endsAt|null }, scope?, ownerPermissions? }) → Set; active exclusive (ban) roles override; else default ∪ active; keeps "<application>." and "account." permissions; ∩ scope ∩ ownerPermissions
- /ban-length: banLength([{ schedule: (seconds | "permanent")[], previousOffenses }]) → max penalty (permanent wins); schedule[min(previousOffenses, last)]
- /recovery-code: createRecoveryCodes(count = 10) → "XXXX-XXXX-XXXX" (alphabet 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ); normalizeRecoveryCode(code) → uppercase, no spaces or hyphens; hash with hashOneTimeCode(…, { purpose: "recovery:<account id>" })
- /email-contact: normalizeEmail(address) → trimmed lowercase (throws if not x@y); emailLedgerForm(address) → also without +tag
- Storage: migrateAccount(database) (own table account_migration) creates application (seeded "account"), account (id uuid v7, kind person|agent, username, owner_id for agents, created_at, last_active_at; unique lower(username)), contact (account_id, kind, value normalized, verified_at, sign_in; unique (kind, value) where verified; deferred trigger: a person keeps ≥1 verified sign-in contact, error 23514), audit_event (append-only; updates raise). Types: AccountDatabase at /account-database/type. Tests: /test-database createTestAccountDatabase()
- /person-account: createPersonAccount(database, { username, contact: { kind, value }, now? }) → { created: true, accountId, contactId } | { created: false, reason: "username-invalid" | "username-taken" | "contact-taken" }; contact stored verified; audit account.created
- /username-availability: usernameAvailability(database, name) → "available" | "taken" | "invalid" (rate limit callers)
- /username-change: changeUsername(database, { accountId, username }) → { changed: true } | { changed: false, reason: "username-invalid" | "username-taken" | "no-account" }; audit detail { from, to }
- /contact-lookup: findAccountByContact(database, contact) → { accountId, contactId, signIn } | undefined (verified only)
- /contact-addition: addContact(database, { accountId, contact, now? }) → { added: true, contactId } | { added: false, reason: "already-added" | "contact-taken" | "no-account" } (unverified)
- /contact-verification: verifyContact(database, { accountId, contactId, now? }) → { verified: true } | { verified: false, reason: "no-contact" | "contact-taken" }
- /contact-removal: removeContact(database, { accountId, contactId }) → { removed: true } | { removed: false, reason: "no-contact" | "last-sign-in-contact" }
- /code-request: requestCode(database, { purpose: "sign-in" | "contact-verification" | "step-up", contact, accountId?, pepper, length = 8, lifetimeSeconds = 600, now? }) → { requestId, code, contact (normalized), expiresAt }; stores HMAC of `${purpose}:${requestId}`; voids open requests for same contact+purpose; table code_request
- /code-verification: verifyCode(database, { requestId, code, purpose, pepper, maximumAttempts = 5, now? }) → { valid: true, contact, accountId | null } | { valid: false, reason: "unknown" | "used" | "replaced" | "expired" | "attempts" | "wrong" }; row locked FOR UPDATE
- /code-request-prune: pruneCodeRequests(database, { before }) → number deleted (expires_at < before)
- /contact-kind: normalizeContact({ kind, value }) (email only; throws otherwise), CONTACT_KINDS
- /audit-event: recordAuditEvent(database, { action, accountId?, actorAccountId?, application?, detail?, now? }) → id
- /database-error: databaseError(error) → { code, constraint } | undefined
